outcome: Resistance index of umbilical artery (RI of UA)
Resistance index of middle cerebral artery (RI of MCA)
cohort: The study included 100 singleton pregnancies between 28 and 40 gestational weeks, with 50 women having preeclampsia (control group) and 50 women having both preeclampsia and fetal growth restriction (experimental group).
finding: Pregnancies with both preeclampsia and IUGR showed a higher resistance index in the umbilical artery, a lower cerebro-placental ratio, and significantly lower Apgar scores compared to pregnancies with preeclampsia alone.
mod_finding: Vaginal labor was more common in the group with preeclampsia only, while C-sections were more common in the group with both preeclampsia and IUGR.
